title: Increasing subsequence of length k

problem.name: Increasing subsequence of length k
problem.statement_latex: Given an indexed sequence $x_1,\ldots,x_n$ from a totally ordered finite domain and fixed $k$, decide whether $i_1<\cdots<i_k$ with $x_{i_1}<\cdots<x_{i_k}$ exist. Complexity counts random-access time.
problem.statement_text: Given an indexed sequence $x_1,\ldots,x_n$ from a totally ordered finite domain and fixed $k$, decide whether $i_1<\cdots<i_k$ with $x_{i_1}<\cdots<x_{i_k}$ exist. Complexity counts random-access time.
